svg.title: BCDC historical advertisement lockup
svg.desc: Geometric reconstruction from the three supplied newspaper references. Four repeated prism modules; four compound filled paths with twelve transparent face openings. This is a reconstruction, not an authenticated original master. Lettering is an optically fitted Nimbus Roman Regular approximation with a 0.35-unit optical spread, converted to filled outlines; the historical typeface has not been confirmed. Address retained as a separate historical layout, not current contact information.
